map.输入皮重、液比与硫化钠浓度，按制革脱毛配方估算所需脱毛液总量及硫化钠投加量，辅助: Enter the hide weight, the liquor ratio and the sodium sulphide concentration to estimate the total depilation liquor and the sulphide dosage for a leather dehairing formula, helping process staff set the materials quickly and optimise the dehairing parameters.
map.：液量(L) = 皮重(kg) × 液比；硫化钠用量(kg) = 液量 × 浓度: : liquor volume (L) = hide weight (kg) x liquor ratio; sodium sulphide (kg) = liquor volume x concentration% / 100; percentage of hide weight = sulphide / hide weight x 100. All materials are dosed by liquor volume and concentration, so any change in hide weight forces a recalculation.
map.：皮重 100 kg、液比 2.0、浓度 3%：液量 = 200 L，硫化钠 =: : hide weight 100 kg, liquor ratio 2.0, concentration 3%: liquor volume = 200 L, sodium sulphide = 200x3/100 = 6.0 kg, which is 6/100x100 = 6.0% of the hide weight. With a liquor ratio of 1.5 the volume is 150 L and the sulphide drops to 4.5 kg, so the hide weight share becomes 4.5% and the depilation effect must be re-validated.
